title: Writing / Style / Prepositions
slide_intent: Prefer natural word order so a simple question feels direct rather than ceremonious.
strategic_value: A side-by-side question can help Duolingo preserve approachable speech in product copy.
demonstration: The preferred question ends with with; the alternative rearranges it into a formal with whom construction.
practical_value: Keep the final preposition when moving it would make the line less natural.
